purpose: Permit priorities, means, interests and targets to evolve when simulated events justify a change; no deterministic reproduction of literary arcs.
truth_vs_belief_gate: Statements reflect speaker's awareness and report; third parties do not automatically inherit inner motives.
future_divergence_gate: No historical transition fires unless simulated actor experiences sufficiently analogous cues and chooses it based on its own constraints; outcomes never preassigned.
stability_gate: Do not invent permanent changes, numeric utility weights or irreversible romance from a single scene.

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Reach Class A and earn elder brother Manabu's respect by individual academic and athletic excellence, working mostly alone
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Reach Class A and earn Manabu's respect with the assistance of reciprocal alliances rather than relying solely on isolated excellence
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Realized her inability to resolve Ryūen's and Sudō's crises alone and recognized Sudō's struggle for respect
transitions.behavioral_evidence: The desired final rank and brother's admiration are retained; the strategy changes. She reports growing through defeat.
contingent_alternatives: Sufficient peer support may stabilize cooperation
Future betrayal, status anxiety or conflict may challenge it
transitions.simulation_guard: Do not force her to be collaborative in every alternate timeline or remove brother-recognition motivation

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Treat setbacks primarily as humiliation and direct evidence of inferior personal ability
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Treat a setback as evidence for revising means, recognizing team strengths and planning future class advancement
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Class D finishes last, Suzune is injured and learns how relying on Sudō changes their available choices
transitions.behavioral_evidence: States defeat helped her grow, admits own shortcomings, thanks Sudō and negotiates mutual behavioral expectations
contingent_alternatives: Additional failures may deepen cooperative stance
Success or renewed rivalry may alter response
transitions.simulation_guard: This is a changed interpretation of failure, not a guarantee of future victory

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Excel in basketball and seek recognition from peers, with competitive excellence as a visible means
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Also seek Suzune's positive regard and closer relationship, using festival MVP and first-name privilege as an immediate proposed route
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Kiyotaka recognizes Sudō's crush; Suzune formerly defended him and Sudō seeks permission to call her Suzune
transitions.behavioral_evidence: Intensifies training and stakes romantic/social closeness on performance, while Suzune does not reciprocally declare romantic feelings
contingent_alternatives: Encouragement may affect choice to train
Rejection or alternate bonds may change which person's validation matters
transitions.simulation_guard: Never convert his affection into guaranteed reciprocation or a fixed all-costs obsession

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Prove worth through winning and command teammates despite anger, seeking recognition from classmates and Suzune
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Gain respect as a trusted ally while retaining competitive sport ambition and accepting a conditional restraint against violence
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Suzune visits him, validates his effort outside basketball and proposes mutual support through graduation; later grants first-name privilege
transitions.behavioral_evidence: Returns, apologizes, performs strongly in the relay and agrees not to use unjustified violence
contingent_alternatives: Support and earned trust may improve restraint
Provocation and shame may still cause relapse
transitions.simulation_guard: Do not rewrite previous aggression as never having happened, nor assume permanent reform

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Publicly participate in the class effort to reach Class A and maintain a beloved trustworthy persona
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Secretly prioritize expelling Suzune to conceal past exposure, subordinating Class A advancement until afterward
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Kiyotaka confronts her with evidence of roster leakage and recalls her Zodiac VIP collaboration with Ryūen
transitions.behavioral_evidence: Explicitly admits the roster leak and says she would sacrifice Class A ambitions if necessary to expel Suzune
contingent_alternatives: New leverage, threats, and audience may affect tactics
After target removal she says she intends to pursue Class A
transitions.simulation_guard: Separate public-facing objectives from private statements and do not presume the stated plan always succeeds

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Target Suzune's expulsion as the overriding perceived protection against past exposure
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Add Kiyotaka to the target list after he understands and challenges her secret actions
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Kiyotaka reveals awareness of roster leak and secret motives and discusses consequences of evidence
transitions.behavioral_evidence: Says she has reconsidered one thing: she now wants Kiyotaka expelled as well, prior to a Class A push
contingent_alternatives: Continued secrecy and exposure risk influence this aim
Changed leverage or reconciliation could alter later goals
transitions.simulation_guard: Statement of desired expulsion is not proof either student is expelled

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Compete for school standing while exploiting opponents and controlling Class C
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Prefer psychologically breaking Suzune and securing submission/possible points even when this reduces tournament score optimization
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Suzune resists his planned matchups, alleged staged injury and coercive demand
transitions.behavioral_evidence: States he had no interest in festival victory relative to crushing her, demands large points and kneeling; Suzune begins kneeling but he does not complete his demands
contingent_alternatives: Future rivals or resources could alter the target's priority
A failed coercion can drive new information goals
transitions.simulation_guard: Source allegation of induced injury and 500000 offered points is not independently verified payment

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Extract points and force Suzune to complete public or private submission
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Suspend immediate pressure and investigate who anticipated the plan and sent the incriminating prior audio
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Anonymous recording arrives while Suzune is beginning to kneel; the audio suggests unauthorized capture of earlier Class C plotting
transitions.behavioral_evidence: States that he failed to collect the points and to make Suzune kneel as intended, and explicitly withholds attribution of sender identity
contingent_alternatives: More evidence may identify sender
Another advantage may revive coercive plan
transitions.simulation_guard: He suspects possibilities, including Kiyotaka, but does not KNOW that he sent the message

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Help Class D avoid losses while concealing his capabilities and controlling his direct intervention
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Accept the immediate risk of not swapping a compromised roster so Suzune can discover the spy and learn to recover Sudō herself
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: He knows or strongly suspects roster compromise and privately wishes Suzune to handle it, despite Hirata noting alternatives
transitions.behavioral_evidence: Does not implement Hirata's immediate countermeasure, speaks harshly to Horikita, and misattributes agency when briefing Hirata
contingent_alternatives: If the divergence changes school stakes he may choose direct intervention
If Suzune acts differently the result may change
transitions.simulation_guard: Never assert as canonical fact he deliberately engineered all Class D losses or that all class defeats must occur

transitions.prior_goal_or_means: Maintain a low public profile and minimize visible extraordinary athletics
transitions.observed_goal_or_means_after: Temporarily value an authentic test against Manabu over anonymity, while predicting the Class D group could improve in future
transitions.trigger_or_new_information: Class D's poor festival trajectory and encounter with Manabu during relay make a head-to-head opportunity possible
transitions.behavioral_evidence: Sprints seriously despite the exposure cost, states he already knows outcome, and expresses a premonition of later class strength
contingent_alternatives: Opportunity cost and attention risk may alter willingness in other timelines
His perceived rival may change
transitions.simulation_guard: Predicted future growth is not proof he purposefully made Class D last or that maximal physical comparison is resolved
